environment: Node vm with in-memory DOM, Canvas/Image observations and synthetic engine messages; no browser, no network, no real-combat claim

cases.name: Public API alias CQC55 remains the same live object as CQC56
Start, next and previous display their own text, title and location
Journal at the first introduction excludes all later scenes and battles
Lore dialog exposes narrative framing without advancing progress
Scene skip reaches briefing and never launches a duel behind the prose
Backing to menu then resuming preserves the exact narrative page
Old 0.55 save slots load through 0.56 with current progress preserved
Corrupt newer save falls back to the other valid slot
Storage denial still permits narrative play and exposes a temporary-save message
Gallery exposes started introduction and keeps every unfinished ending disabled
Replaying and rewinding the gallery never changes campaign progress
The actual 0.55 handshake launches one duel with validated route and frozen rules
Foreign windows and wrong protocol versions cannot trigger readiness
Repeated ready and started messages do not restart the same duel
A result from the wrong stage, token or opponent never advances the story
Both fighters cannot simultaneously have the required winning rounds
One valid result advances once and a duplicate cannot award another victory
A defeat and explicit retry consume exactly one continue
Interrupted fight resumes at briefing and discards old-session results
A fresh runtime reload converts a saved active fight into an untouched briefing
Keyboard and touch owners release independently and pause releases all held controls
Missing ready response returns safely to briefing without consuming a continue
Missing start acknowledgement returns safely to briefing after the handshake
Standalone story passes decoded embedded engine HTML without a network src
Malformed import cannot abort an ongoing valid duel or replace progress
Successful import closes a stale pause dialog and returns to the imported menu
Eight protocol wins unlock one ending, full outro and gallery without an extra clear
Loaded introduction and ending paintings use different actual source cells without distortion
Unloaded or failed paintings invoke a procedural fallback and report artReady false
A late painting load replaces the fallback without changing the current story page
Illustration viewer shows only the current scene and returns without changing progress or reading position
Illustration viewer pauses automatic reading until it closes, then restarts the current page delay
A viewer painting arriving after opening redraws without animation, navigation or progression changes
A previous scene image finishing late cannot replace the current scene painting
The gallery viewer preserves campaign state and cannot reveal an unfinished ending
Illustration access is absent from battle briefings and cannot open a stale narrative panel
Inputs remain unchanged during behavioral verification
